description: Return the current TronSave market depth/price tiers for ENERGY or BANDWIDTH via the api-key REST endpoint. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use before `tronsave_internal_order_create` or `tronsave_internal_order_estimate` when the user needs live prices or liquidity. Read-only. FRESHNESS: live market depth can change roughly every 3 seconds (one TRON block) — re-read immediately before placing an order.
